component.name: Ray
component.summary: A distributed ray tracer from 1997, rebuilt

description.p: Ray is a ray tracer written in 1996–1997 that splits rendering across a network of machines, rebuilt in 2026. Its scene editor shows a scene in a shaded OpenGL view and ray-traces it in place; raythrower renders from the command line with threads or with rayengine processes on other machines.

It traces real camera lenses surface by surface, spectral dispersion, rough glass and metal, area and spot lights, sky lighting, bounce light, haze, solid textures and a library of natural materials, meshes from STL, OBJ, glTF and Blender files, and shapes from CSG to fractals.
